changelog: v0.8.4: 1) Avatar Emotional Personas: Dynamic personality tones (Warm, Witty, Feisty, Zen, Cyberpunk, Cheerful) with automatic avatar-binding and manual user override; 2) Antigravity Brevity Defense: Injected conversational VR system prompt and deterministic 2-sentence clamping to maintain instantaneous VR audio response; 3) Multi-Client Backend Concurrency: Stateless dialogue trajectory support enabling simultaneous sessions across Quest 3 and mobile devices.
